title: Password Recovery and Librarian-Assisted Password Reset Flowchart

nodes.label: Save password and revoke old sessions
Sign in and replace temporary password
Show error and retry within limits

note: Recovery uses a previously verified email. Registration SMS does not enable SMS password recovery.

title: Profile Password Change Flowchart

nodes.label: Enter current password and repeat new password
Revoke old sessions and replace current session

note: New passwords require 8-128 characters and at least one digit. The current password must be correct.

title: Member Profile and Profile Photo Management Flowchart

nodes.label: Remove owned photo and clear avatar

note: Members cannot edit their name. Failed validation or storage operations show an error and retain the last confirmed state. Profile photos are separate from Face ID.

title: Email Change and Verification Flowchart

nodes.label: Enter new email if changing and confirm current password
Save any email change as unverified
Show error or request another code within limits

note: The code must match the current saved email and verification purpose. An entered email is not automatically verified.

title: Reservation Queue, Cancellation, and Expiry Flowchart

nodes.label: Cancel permitted reservation and release capacity
Pick up at counter before deadline
Librarian records loan and fulfills reservation
Release capacity and promote next queued member
Mark next eligible request ready and set 24-hour deadline

note: Queued reservations do not hold a physical copy. Expiry and promotion are synchronized by relevant requests and inventory operations; refreshing does not extend a deadline.

title: Inventory Editing, Stock Adjustment, and Book Deletion Flowchart

nodes.label: Edit metadata, description, cover or copy total
Save metadata and adjust permitted physical stock
Keep existing copy codes and loan history
Delete only if permitted or show history restriction

note: Stock reduction retires eligible copies. Borrowed copies, ready-reservation capacity and historical identities remain protected.

title: Bulk ISBN Lookup and Workbook Import Flowchart

nodes.label: Look up books and preview results
Review and select entries to add
Show individual added, skipped or failed results
Import valid rows and skip duplicate ISBNs
Create copies and QR codes and show import summary

note: Invalid files stop with an error. Workbook results can contain partial row errors. Resolve uncertain saves using the original request before retrying.

title: Member Suspension, Reactivation, and Account Deletion Flowchart

nodes.label: Choose Delete Account and confirm librarian password
Check outstanding loans and private-file ownership
Show restriction and resolve the issue
Remove permitted private data and disable account

note: Account deletion is blocked while books remain outstanding. Deletion follows the existing soft-deletion and private-upload ownership rules.

title: Face Enrollment, Replacement, and Deletion Flowchart

nodes.label: Capture and preview a live face
Show failure and keep existing enrollment
Choose Delete Face Data and enter librarian password
Delete permitted face templates and snapshots
Revoke member sessions and refresh status

note: Invalid librarian credentials prevent deletion. Face data is separate from a profile photo; face deletion does not remove loan history.

title: Personalized Book Recommendations and Favorites Flowchart

nodes.label: Use content or popularity fallback when needed
Display Trending, What is new and Books we love
Select heart to add or remove
Save own favorite and refresh confirmed state
View book details or continue browsing

note: Books we love and Most loved use favorites, not star ratings. New members start with Trending; recommendations use on-demand activity and fallback signals.

title: Loan Issue Reporting and Notifications Flowchart

nodes.label: Select Report Issue on an outstanding loan
Choose reason and enter optional note
Librarian opens and reviews the issue
Show error without creating a report

note: An issue report does not return a book, collect payment or create condition photos. In-app notifications do not imply email or SMS delivery.

title: Bulk Physical-Copy QR Label Printing and Export Flowchart

nodes.label: Print and match labels to copies
Generate all label batches and verify count
Build ZIP only after all batches succeed

note: Invalid selections or failed batches show an error and preserve the selection for retry. Reprinting never creates stock or changes a physical-copy identity.

title: System Settings and Entrance Station PIN Management Flowchart

nodes.label: Enter current password and repeat new PIN

note: PINs contain 6-12 digits. The existing PIN is never displayed. Older station sessions fail a subsequent PIN check after replacement.

title: Librarian Dashboard and Navigation Flowchart

nodes.label: Choose Inventory, Members, Circulation, Reports or Settings
Choose another workspace through the menu
Revoke current session and return to public portal

note: The sidebar starts hidden on desktop and mobile. Server authorization remains enforced for each workspace.

title: Book Category Review and Catalog Visibility Flowchart

nodes.label: Load hidden labels and master categories
Show error and retain unresolved state
Update books with the exact original label

note: Category review resolves hidden labels to an existing master category. A suggestion alone does not save the mapping.
